faqsubtitle: Find answers to common questions about our gaming platform.

faqItems.question: How do I create an account?
faqItems.answer: To create an account, click on the 'Sign Up' button in the top right corner of the homepage. Fill in your details, including your email address and a secure password. Verify your email, and you're ready to start gaming!

faqItems.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqItems.answer: We accept a variety of payment methods including credit/debit cards, PayPal, and various cryptocurrencies. You can view all available options in your account settings under the 'Payment Methods' section.

faqItems.question: How do I join a game or tournament?
faqItems.answer: Browse our list of available games or tournaments from the main dashboard. Click on the game you want to join, review the entry requirements and fees, then click 'Join Game' to enter. Make sure you have sufficient funds in your account before joining.

faqItems.question: What if I experience technical issues during a game?
faqItems.answer: If you encounter any technical issues, please contact our support team immediately through the in-game help feature or by emailing support@wagerx.ng. We recommend taking a screenshot of the issue to help us resolve it quickly.

faqItems.question: How are winnings paid out?
faqItems.answer: Winnings are automatically credited to your account balance after the game or tournament concludes and results are verified. You can then withdraw your winnings using your preferred payment method from the 'Withdraw' section in your account settings.
